changes.detail: Added endpoint to create a refund.
changes.migration: If you previously used charge reversal, switch to POST /refunds for explicit refund objects.

changes.detail: Added optional breakdown of fees and taxes.
changes.migration: No client change required unless you want to display fee breakdowns.

changes.detail: Request now requires idempotency_key to prevent duplicate charges.
changes.migration: Generate and persist an idempotency key per checkout attempt.

changes.detail: Charge.status is now an enum with values: pending|succeeded|failed.
changes.migration: Update client-side status handling to accept the new enum values.

changes.detail: The card expansion is deprecated; use expand=payment_method instead.
changes.migration: Replace expand=card with expand=payment_method in queries.
